name: @rzmps/rzmps
description: 🧅 Modular and extendable particle system for Three.js

scripts.build: tsc && npm run build:shaders && npm run copy:assets && npm run fix:shader-imports
scripts.copy:assets: mkdir -p build && rm -rf build/assets && cp -r src/assets build/assets
scripts.dev: concurrently -k "tsc --watch" "watch 'npm run build:shaders && npm run fix:shader-imports' src/shaders" "watch 'npm run copy:assets' src/assets"

author: Robert May
